dedupe_keys.name: global 1 km solar photovoltaic resource technical and economic potential with google earth engine code

description: This data set gives global 1 km raster layers of solar photovoltaic potential at three levels, with country summaries and Google Earth Engine code. It was published by Boxiong Su, Mingquan Wu and co-authors with a study on global fine-scale assessment of PV potential using Google Earth Engine. The resource layer is based on irradiance; the technical layer excludes land by terrain, land use, slope and protected areas; and the economic layer keeps cells with a payback period of 15 years or less within 50 km of roads or settlements. Country tables aggregate potential under each scenario using high-resolution administrative boundaries. Coverage is global at 1 km resolution. Data are one ZIP of about 612 MB on Zenodo (August 2025), with a later record (November 2025) adding commented payback period code, under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the economic screen uses simple payback and distance rules, and results depend on the input layers chosen by the authors. Simulation uses are siting and capacity planning for solar PV. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
